title: Iron & Engine Express
author: MarcadoVicciNut
desc:
Built for trainees who want the mechanical tension of compound lifting without sacrificing bodyweight work capacity and aerobic fitness.

Iron & Engine Express is a 5-day hybrid routine structured strictly for a 40-minute training window. By pairing heavy compound strength lifts with functional tempo work and finishing with high-density AMRAPs and EMOMs, this program builds muscle, bulletproofs joints, and develops serious gymnastics conditioning without running you into the ground.

ex.n: Warm-up Routine (Squats, World's Greatest Stretch, Glute Bridges)
ex.note: Warm-up (5 mins): 2 rounds of 10 bodyweight squats, 5 world’s greatest stretch/side, 10 glute bridges.

ex.n: Squat (Barbell)
ex.note: 3-second lowering phase, a 1-second pause, an explosive lift, and a 1-second pause at the top

ex.n: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
Hanging Knee Raise

ss.note:
10 Kettlebell / DB Swings
10 Goblet Squats (or Jump Squats)
10 Push-ups (or Burpees)
10 Min AMRAP : DB Goblet Squat, Push-ups, Lunges - 8,10,12.

ex.n: Warm-up Routine (Band Pull-Aparts, Arm Circles, Scap Pulls)
ex.note: Band pull-aparts, arm circles, scapular push-ups/pull-ups.

ex.n: Bench Press (Barbell)
Warm-up Routine (Hip Hinges, Cat-Cow, Light KB Deadlifts)
Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
ex.note: Rest 90s

Ab Wheel
